recipes.title: Add an API route with validation
recipes.summary: Export HTTP methods from src/routes/api, validate params/query/body at the trust boundary, and return stable errors.
recipes.when: A client or service needs JSON rather than HTML.

recipes.title: Add session auth
recipes.summary: Store sessions server-side, rotate the session on login, and protect a route with a guard.
recipes.when: You need login/logout and per-request user identity.

recipes.title: Cache loader data and invalidate it
recipes.summary: Opt into loader caching with revalidate/cacheTags, then invalidate by path or tag after a mutation.
recipes.when: A read-heavy page can tolerate a short stale window.

recipes.title: Deploy static or edge output
recipes.summary: Prerender static routes or build a fetch-handler bundle, then deploy the generated directory.
recipes.when: You need a CDN/static host or an edge/serverless runtime instead of a Node process.

recipes.title: Add a dynamic route
recipes.summary: Map a URL segment or catch-all to a page, read params in the loader, and validate them.
recipes.when: The URL contains an identifier, slug, or nested path.

recipes.title: Handle a form with a server action
recipes.summary: Validate FormData, mutate on the server, redirect or return a result, and keep no-JS submission working.
recipes.when: A page needs a mutation without a separate JSON API endpoint.

recipes.title: Add a page with a loader
recipes.summary: Create a server-rendered page whose data is loaded on each request and embedded in the hydration payload.
recipes.when: The page needs request-time data from a database, API, or environment.

recipes.title: Test a route in-process
recipes.summary: Exercise the real handler with an in-memory host, assert SSR/API behavior, then add a browser check.
recipes.when: You changed routes, loaders, actions, validation, or security limits.
